name: Read Mandatory Documentation
description: Ensures agents read AGENTS.md and any mandatory documentation specified in their instructions before taking any action in the AssessmentBot workspace
prompt:
BEFORE DOING ANYTHING ELSE in the AssessmentBot workspace, you MUST read the following mandatory documentation:

1. CORE INSTRUCTIONS: /workspaces/AssessmentBot/AGENTS.md (This contains the Core Agent Contract which is MANDATORY per section 1 Read-First Rule)
2. COMPONENT-SPECIFIC INSTRUCTIONS for any modules you'll work with:
   - Backend work: /workspaces/AssessmentBot/src/backend/AGENTS.md
   - Frontend work: /workspaces/AssessmentBot/src/frontend/AGENTS.md
   - Builder scripts: /workspaces/AssessmentBot/scripts/builder/AGENTS.md
3. ANY MANDATORY READING specified in your agent instructions or task description
4. ANY ADDITIONAL DOCUMENTATION mentioned as required in the current task

REQUIRED ACTION: Use the read_file tool to read all relevant AGENTS.md files and any other mandatory documentation mentioned in your instructions or task.

STATE IN YOUR FIRST MESSAGE:
- Which AGENTS.md files you have read
- Which mandatory documentation from your instructions you have read
- Any other relevant documentation needed for this task

NEVER proceed with any actions until you have read this mandatory documentation. This is a strict requirement per AssessmentBot Core Agent Contract section 1: Failing to read these files WILL result in you failing your task.
